oracle.derivation: gm(t) = 0.1 sin(w0 t), so gm_{-1} = 0.05j. With P1 driven, v(rf) = sqrt(z0) a1 (z0 against R1 = 50); the lower sideband current gm_{-1} v(rf) flows into z0 || R2 = 25 ohm, so b2 = 25 * 0.05j a1 = 1.25j a1, conjugated for the lower band: S21 = -1.25j. Both ports see 50 ohm and the multiplier is unilateral, so S11 = S22 = S12 = 0. Noise at 290 K: the RF node carries 50 kT (V^2/Hz) from P1's z0 and 50 kT from R1 in each of the bands f and 2 f0 - f, both converted by |25 * 0.05|^2 = 1.5625 into the IF band; R2 adds 50 kT at the IF node. F_ssb = (4 * 50 kT * 1.5625 + 50 kT) / (50 kT * 1.5625) = 4.64.
